sketch--noun.def: A quick rough drawing, or a short funny scene.
sketch--noun.ex: He made a sketch of the harbour in pencil.
sketch--noun.exTr: Limanın kurşun kalemle bir eskizini yaptı.

buzzer--noun.def: A device that makes a buzzing sound as a signal.

sentimental--adj.def: Based on feelings rather than reason, sometimes too much so.
sentimental--adj.ex: The watch has sentimental value only.
sentimental--adj.exTr: Saatin yalnızca duygusal bir değeri var.

salvation--noun.def: Being saved from danger or from sin.
salvation--noun.ex: The loan was the salvation of the company.

hence--adv.def: For this reason, in formal English.
hence--adv.ex: The bridge is unsafe; hence the closure.
hence--adv.exTr: Köprü güvenli değil; bu nedenle kapatıldı.

craft--verb.def: To make something skilfully by hand.
craft--verb.ex: He crafted the chair from a single log.
craft--verb.exTr: Sandalyeyi tek bir kütükten özenle yaptı.

chart--verb.def: To record changes over time, often on a graph.
chart--verb.ex: The study charts the fall in rainfall.

magnetic--adj.def: Able to attract metal, or attracting people strongly.
magnetic--adj.ex: She has a magnetic presence on stage.

anchor--verb.def: To hold a ship with an anchor, or to fix something firmly.
anchor--verb.ex: They anchored the boat in the bay.

gypsy--noun.def: A member of a travelling people, an older and now often offensive word.
gypsy--noun.ex: The song comes from a gypsy tradition.

pigeon--noun.def: A common grey bird found in towns.
pigeon--noun.ex: A pigeon landed on the statue.

conviction--noun.def: A court's decision that someone is guilty, or a strong belief.

frost--verb.def: To cover with frost, or to make glass cloudy.

prophet--noun.def: A person believed to bring messages from God.
prophet--noun.ex: The story concerns an ancient prophet.

compromised--adj.def: Weakened, or no longer safe or private.
compromised--adj.exTr: Sistemin güvenliği bir gecede ihlal edildi.

facial--adj.ex: The injury left no facial scar.

facial--noun.def: A beauty treatment for the skin of the face.
facial--noun.ex: She booked a facial for Friday.
facial--noun.exTr: Cuma için yüz bakımı randevusu aldı.

meaningless--adj.def: Having no purpose or no importance.
meaningless--adj.ex: Without context the figure is meaningless.

fuse--verb.def: To join two things into one, often by heating.

inheritance--noun.def: Money or property received from someone who has died.
inheritance--noun.ex: She used the inheritance to open a shop.
inheritance--noun.exTr: Mirası bir dükkân açmak için kullandı.

classy--adj.ex: It is a classy little restaurant.

ruthless--adj.def: Determined to succeed without caring who is hurt.

preacher--noun.def: A person who gives religious talks.
preacher--noun.ex: The preacher spoke for an hour.

swap--verb.def: To exchange one thing for another.
swap--verb.ex: They swapped seats at the interval.

swap--noun.def: An exchange of one thing for another.

premises--noun.def: The building and land used by a business.
premises--noun.ex: Smoking is banned on these premises.

convict--verb.def: To decide officially in court that someone is guilty.
convict--verb.ex: The court convicted him of fraud.

convict--noun.def: A person found guilty and sent to prison.

stray--verb.def: To move away from the right place or subject.
stray--verb.ex: The sheep strayed onto the road.

stray--adj.def: Lost or with no home, said of an animal.
stray--adj.ex: A stray cat sleeps by the door.
stray--adj.exTr: Kapının yanında bir sokak kedisi uyuyor.

stray--noun.def: An animal that has no home.

profound--adj.def: Very great, or showing deep understanding.
profound--adj.ex: The book had a profound effect on her.
profound--adj.exTr: Kitabın onun üzerinde derin bir etkisi oldu.

peasant--noun.def: A poor farmer who works a small piece of land.
peasant--noun.ex: The painting shows a peasant at work.

carrier--noun.def: A company that transports goods, or a person carrying a disease.

injustice--noun.def: A situation in which people are treated unfairly.
injustice--noun.ex: The film exposes a great injustice.
injustice--noun.exTr: Film büyük bir adaletsizliği ortaya koyuyor.

elaborate--adj.ex: The ceiling has an elaborate pattern.

elaborate--verb.def: To explain something in more detail.
elaborate--verb.ex: Could you elaborate on that point?

mechanism--noun.def: The parts that make a machine work, or a way something happens.

slack--verb.def: To work less hard than you should.

slack--noun.def: The loose part of a rope that is not pulled tight.
slack--noun.ex: Take up the slack in the line.

slack--adj.def: Loose, or with little business activity.

psychiatric--adj.def: Relating to the treatment of mental illness.
psychiatric--adj.ex: He works in a psychiatric hospital.

coverage--noun.def: The reporting of an event, or what an insurance policy includes.
coverage--noun.ex: The coverage of the election was thorough.

harassment--noun.def: Repeated behaviour that annoys or threatens someone.
harassment--noun.ex: The company has a harassment policy.

irony--noun.def: The use of words to mean the opposite, or a strange contrast.
irony--noun.ex: The irony was lost on him.

bliss--noun.ex: A quiet evening at home is bliss.
bliss--noun.exTr: Evde sakin bir akşam tam bir mutluluk.

jurisdiction--noun.def: The official power to make legal decisions in an area.
jurisdiction--noun.ex: The case falls outside their jurisdiction.

carpenter--noun.def: A person who makes and repairs wooden things.

juvenile--noun.def: A young person who is not yet an adult in law.

juvenile--adj.def: Relating to young people, or childish in behaviour.

strap--noun.def: A narrow band of leather or cloth used to fasten or carry.
strap--noun.ex: The bag strap broke on the bus.

strap--verb.def: To fasten something with a strap.
strap--verb.ex: They strapped the load onto the roof.

suspension--noun.def: A temporary stop, or the springs supporting a vehicle.
suspension--noun.exTr: İki maçlık bir cezayla karşı karşıya.

numb--adj.def: Unable to feel anything, in body or in emotion.
numb--adj.ex: My fingers were numb with cold.

numb--verb.def: To make a part of the body unable to feel.

screenplay--noun.def: The written script of a film.
screenplay--noun.ex: She wrote the screenplay in six weeks.

chilly--adj.def: Cold enough to be uncomfortable, or unfriendly.

torment--verb.def: To make someone suffer, in body or in mind.
torment--verb.exTr: Suçluluk duygusu ona yıllarca eziyet etti.

torment--noun.def: Great suffering of the body or the mind.

resent--verb.def: To feel angry because you think you were treated unfairly.

flick--verb.def: To move something quickly with a small sharp movement.
flick--verb.ex: He flicked the switch and the lights came on.

tailor--noun.def: A person who makes clothes to fit one customer.

tailor--verb.def: To make or change something to suit a particular need.
tailor--verb.ex: The course is tailored to beginners.

remorse--noun.def: Deep regret for something wrong you have done.
remorse--noun.ex: He showed no remorse in court.

gem--noun.def: A precious stone, or something of great value.
gem--noun.ex: The little museum is a real gem.

testament--noun.def: Clear proof of something, or a will.
testament--noun.ex: The bridge is a testament to their skill.

immense--adj.def: Extremely large in size or degree.

provoke--verb.def: To make someone angry, or to cause a reaction.
provoke--verb.ex: The remark provoked a long argument.
provoke--verb.exTr: Bu söz uzun bir tartışmaya yol açtı.

hostess--noun.def: A woman who receives guests, or who serves on a plane.
hostess--noun.ex: Our hostess welcomed every guest by name.
hostess--noun.exTr: Ev sahibemiz her konuğu adıyla karşıladı.

adrenaline--noun.def: A substance the body makes when you are excited or afraid.

contractor--noun.def: A person or company paid to do work for another.
contractor--noun.ex: The contractor finished ahead of time.

refreshing--adj.def: Making you feel less tired, or pleasantly different.
refreshing--adj.ex: It is refreshing to hear an honest answer.

bouquet--noun.def: A bunch of flowers arranged and tied together.

flatter--verb.def: To praise someone insincerely, or to make them look good.

descent--noun.def: A move downwards, or a person's family origin.
descent--noun.ex: The descent took longer than the climb.

preach--verb.def: To give a religious talk, or to tell others how to behave.
preach--verb.ex: He preached to a full church.
